programme.title: Ace Ventura: When Nature Calls
programme.desc: Legendary pet detective Ace Ventura returns for another adventure when he's coerced out of retirement while on a soul-searching retreat in the Himalayas. He must now retrieve an endangered white bat from a village located in Africa. The sacred animal was offered up as a wedding dowry from the Wachootoo prince to the Wachati princess, and, if Ace can't track down the culprit behind the kidnapping in time, civil war will break out between the two rival tribes.

programme.title: Ace Ventura: Pet Detective
programme.desc: When the dolphin mascot of Miami's NFL team is abducted, Ace Ventura, a zany private investigator who specializes in finding missing animals, looks into the case. Soon Miami Dolphins players are kidnapped too, including star player Dan Marino, making Ace's sleuth work even more pressing. Working with Dolphins representative Melissa Robinson, Ace closes in on the culprits, but not before many ridiculous misadventures.

programme.title: Jumanji
programme.desc: A magical board game unleashes a world of adventure on siblings Peter and Judy Shepherd. While exploring an old mansion, the youngsters find a curious, jungle-themed game called Jumanji in the attic. When they start playing, they free Alan Parrish, who's been stuck in the game's inner world for decades. If they win Jumanji, the kids can free Alan for good, but that means braving giant bugs, ill-mannered monkeys and even stampeding rhinos!

programme.title: Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle
programme.desc: Four high school kids discover an old video game console and are drawn into the game's jungle setting, literally becoming the adult avatars they chose. What they discover is that you don't just play Jumanji - you must survive it. To beat the game and return to the real world, they'll have to go on the most dangerous adventure of their lives, discover what Alan Parrish left 20 years ago, and change the way they think about themselves - or they'll be stuck in the game forever.

programme.title: Zoo Clues
programme.desc: With all of the various animal species roaming around the planet there's a lot to know about animals, which means no one knows everything about them. Thankfully "Zoo Clues" fills in some of the blanks. Each half-hour episode investigates at least a dozen questions about animals to provide viewers with answers. Have you ever wondered if birds can fly backward, how animals without external ears hear, or why zebras have stripes? Those are among the questions waiting for answers on "Zoo Clues."

programme.title: Animal Atlas
programme.desc: This educational series takes viewers on a journey around the world to meet all kinds of animals, from the familiar to the not-so-familiar. "Animal Atlas" teaches viewers about the animals' lives, histories and adaptations that allow them to survive in their environment. Whether it's visiting monkeys or heading underwater for a look at mammals that live in the ocean, "Animal Atlas" brings animals from around the globe into viewers' homes for an up-close look at how the animals live.

programme.title: The Coolest Places on Earth
programme.desc: If you're expecting this show to feature locations like Antarctica and the North Pole, you may be disappointed because the "coolest" in the title refers to how impressive a place is, not its temperature. Instead, the show explores the history and culture of cities and landmarks that are among the most astonishing sites on the planet. Each episode features three locations, showcasing the history, geography and traditions of each to help young people gain a better understanding of the diverse world in which they live.

programme.title: MLB Tonight
programme.desc: When they're not tuning in to the games themselves, baseball fans know where to turn for their nightly baseball fix. MLB Network's signature program, "MLB Tonight" presents complete coverage of all of the games, beginning with the first pitch on the East Coast and ending with the final out on the West Coast. The Emmy-winning studio show features highlights, live look-ins and breaking news, plus analysis from a rotating roster that includes former players Eric Byrnes, Al Leiter, Dan Plesac, Billy Ripken and Mike Lowell, and inside information men Tom Verducci, Jon Heyman, Peter Gammons and Ken Rosenthal. Greg Amsinger, Brian Kenny and Matt Vasgersian are among the hosts.

Cattleman Dale Kirby (Mady Lawrence) believes the farmers have been stealing cattle, forcing him to borrow from crooked lender Steve Kinney (Jack Ingram). In truth, however, it is Kinney himself who is behind the cattle thefts. When Billy attempts to mediate, he and Fuzzy find themselves threatened by Kinney.

Thompson is questioned by Deputy Walter Gordon (Kermit Maynard) when Gordon's brother, the sheriff, goes missing. While investigating this disappearance, Thompson is given a cryptic clue by rancher Joe Moore (Al Ferguson), but Moore is killed before he can elaborate. Thompson and Gordon must then join forces to find the truth.

programme.title: Down Missouri Way

But upon arrival she is stunned to discover a film crew diligently at work on a new movie. Soon, Jane and her mule companion are swept up in the filmmaking frenzy. While the photogenic mule upstages the production's human star (Renee Godfrey), Jane finds herself falling for the feature's dashing producer (William Wright).

programme.title: Dead Birds

As the group, among it a runaway slave (Isaiah Washington) and a nurse (Nicki Aycox), makes its way along, it stops off to rob a bank clean. Looking to plan a getaway, the gang heads into an empty house to hole up for the evening. As the soldiers start arguing with one another, strange things begin happening in the house -- and everyone in the group soon realizes that the place is haunted.

programme.title: Fußball: 2. Bundesliga
programme.desc: Die 2. Fußball-Bundesliga ist nach der -Bundesliga die höchste Spielklasse im deutschen Männerfußball. Im heutigen fußballerischen Volksmund bezeichnet man sie auch als „Unterhaus“, während die 1. Liga „Oberhaus“ genannt wird. Etabliert wurde die 1974, elf Jahre nach der Gründung ihrer großen Schwester. So sollte die wirtschaftliche Kluft von Profi- und Amateurbereich überwunden werden, die zwischen der Bundesliga und den bis dahin als zweite Liga fungierenden fünf Regionalligen entstanden war. An 34 Spieltagen wird um den Aufstieg bzw. Abstieg gespielt; der Meister sowie der Vize-Meister steigen automatisch in die 1. Liga auf, während sich der Drittplatzierte in zwei Relegationsspielen (Hin- und Rückspiel) mit dem 16. der 1. Bundesliga um den Aufstieg bzw. – aus Sicht des Erstligisten – Verbleib duellieren muss. Anders als im Oberhaus, wo Bayern München mit 32 Titeln seit der Liga-Gründung 1963/64 den unangefochtenen Rekordmeister markiert, gibt es im Unterhaus fünf Co-Rekordmeister. Diese sind der FC Nürnberg, der SC Freiburg, der FC Köln, Arminia Bielefeld und der VfL Bochum, alle mit je vier Titeln.

programme.desc: Une séance de spiritisme lors de la fête d'Halloween de dernière minute de Sam et Jay fait apparaître un esprit du passé d'Hetty; de plus, Isaac craint que Nigel ne soit découragé par son pouvoir fantomatique.

programme.title: Ghosts: fantômes à la maison
programme.desc: Chez les Farnsby, Sam rencontre un fantôme viking qui a un lien inattendu avec Thorfinn; puis, Trevor conçoit une nouvelle méthode pour que les fantômes échangent des faveurs.

programme.title: La belle et la bête
programme.desc: Cat et Vincent doivent trouver une façon de faire face au danger qui approche.

programme.title: La belle et la bête
programme.desc: Cat découvre qu'elle pourrait être enceinte ; Vincent suit une piste qui le met en danger ; J.T. se fait enlever.

programme.title: La belle et la bête
programme.desc: Vincent et Cat réalisent qu'ils doivent se cacher puisque quelqu'un tente de tuer Vincent.

programme.title: Mortelle ressemblance
programme.desc: Avant d'affronter le système carcéral russe pour meurtre, Viktoria Nasyrova s'enfuit aux États-Unis et devient dominatrice à Brooklyn, utilisant sa belle apparence pour manipuler des hommes riches, les droguant et les volant afin de mener une vie de luxe. Toutefois, craignant d'être un jour renvoyée en Russie pour y purger une peine de prison, Viktoria décide de voler l'identité de sa styliste, Olga, qui lui ressemble énormément. Elle l'empoisonne donc, mais Olga survit.

programme.title: Ghosts: fantômes à la maison
programme.desc: Le secret de la disparition du pantalon de Trevor est révélé lorsque son ancien ami vient au manoir Woodstone pour acheter la montre que Sam et Jay ont trouvée sur le cadavre d'Elias Woodstone; Thor décide de dire à Flower ce qu'il ressent pour elle.

programme.title: Ghosts: fantômes à la maison
programme.desc: Le fantôme de Stéphanie, une méchante fille des années 80 morte le soir de son bal de fin d'année, se réveille dans le grenier, ce qui pousse Sam à faire face à ce qui s'est passé lors de son propre bal de fin d'année; Alberta découvre un autre don.

programme.title: La famille fait loi
programme.desc: Un ancien ami de Harry, Fletcher, lui apprend qu'il vient de découvrir qu'il a un fils, né pendant qu'il purgeait une peine de prison pour des délits liés à la drogue; désormais sobre et ayant un emploi stable, il souhaite obtenir la garde partagée de son enfant; Harry plaide avec passion pour qu'on lui accorde une seconde chance; Abby, Daniel et Lucy ont eu le temps de réfléchir à ce que pourrait être leur vie au-delà des murs du cabinet.

programme.title: NCIS: Tony & Ziva
programme.desc: Pour empêcher une attaque internationale meurtrière, Tony et Ziva risquent tout et découvrent à qui ils peuvent faire confiance.

programme.title: Meurtres sous le gui
programme.desc: À l'approche de Noël, Emily continue de résoudre la chasse au trésor tout en traquant un tueur; Violet prépare une surprise pour Sam; puis, le passé mystérieux d'Emily complique son avenir.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Andy and Traci are among the first responders to a home invasion at an upscale address; when the crisis appears to be over, Traci hurries away to handle a personal emergency; Andy must confront the armed suspect alone.

programme.title: Kingsman: The Secret Service
programme.desc: Gary "Eggsy" Unwin (Taron Egerton), whose late father secretly worked for a spy organization, lives in a South London housing estate and seems headed for a life behind bars. However, dapper agent Harry Hart (Colin Firth) recognizes potential in the youth and recruits him to be a trainee in the secret service. Meanwhile, villainous Richmond Valentine (Samuel L. Jackson) launches a diabolical plan to solve the problem of climate change via a worldwide killing spree.

programme.title: Ocean's Eleven
programme.desc: Dapper Danny Ocean is a man of action. Less than 24 hours into his parole from a New Jersey penitentiary, the wry, charismatic thief is already rolling out his next plan. Following three rules: Don't hurt anybody, don't steal from anyone who doesn't deserve it, and play the game like you've got nothing to lose. Danny orchestrates the most sophisticated, elaborate casino heist in history.

programme.title: Ocean's Twelve
programme.desc: After successfully robbing five casinos in one night, Danny Ocean and his crew of thieves have big problems. Despite pulling off one of the biggest heists in Las Vegas history, the members of the gang have already spent much of the money they stole. Casino owner Terry Benedict demands that Ocean return the money, plus millions more in interest. Unable to come up the cash, the crew is forced to come together to pull off another series of heists, this time in Europe.

programme.title: Ocean's Thirteen
programme.desc: Danny Ocean and his gang hatch an ambitious plot for revenge after ruthless casino owner Willy Bank double-crosses Reuben Tishkoff, Danny's friend and mentor. First, Ocean's gang plan to hit Bank in the paycheck by reversing the precept that the house always wins. Next, they will deal a crushing blow to Bank's ego by ruining his reputation as the only hotelier to earn the Royal Review's Five Diamond Award for each of his properties.

programme.title: When Harry Met Sally...
programme.desc: In 1977, college graduates Harry Burns (Billy Crystal) and Sally Albright (Meg Ryan) share a contentious car ride from Chicago to New York, during which they argue about whether men and women can ever truly be strictly platonic friends. Ten years later, Harry and Sally meet again at a bookstore, and in the company of their respective best friends, Jess (Bruno Kirby) and Marie (Carrie Fisher), attempt to stay friends without sex becoming an issue between them.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark
programme.desc: Dr. Indiana Jones, a renowned archeologist and expert in the occult, is hired by the U.S. Government to find the ark of the covenant, which is believed to still hold the Ten Commandments. Unfortunately, Hitler's agents are also after the ark. Indy and his ex-flame Marion escape from various close scrapes in a quest that takes them from Nepal to Cairo.

programme.title: Flags of Our Fathers
programme.desc: In February and March 1945, U.S. troops fight and win one of the most crucial and costly battles of the war on the island of Iwo Jima. A photo of U.S. servicemen raising the flag on Mount Suribachi becomes an iconic symbol of victory to a war-weary nation. The individuals themselves become heroes, though not all survive the war and realize it.

programme.title: Enemy at the Gates
programme.desc: Vassili is a young Russian sharpshooter who becomes a legend when a savvy political officer makes him the hero of his propaganda campaign. Their friendship is threatened when both men fall in love with a beautiful female soldier. As the battle for the city rages, Vassili faces the ultimate challenge when the Nazi command dispatches its most elite marksman to hunt down and kill the man who has become the hope of all Russia.

programme.title: Behind Enemy Lines
programme.desc: A Navy pilot (Owen Wilson) is shot down over enemy territory, and struggles to survive the relentless pursuit of a ruthless secret police enforcer, a deadly tracker, and countless hostile troops. With time running out, the injured pilot's commanding officer (Gene Hackman) goes against orders to carry out a desperate rescue mission.

programme.title: Rush Hour
programme.desc: When a Chinese diplomat's daughter is kidnapped in Los Angeles, he calls in Hong Kong Detective Inspector Lee (Jackie Chan) to assist the FBI with the case. But the FBI doesn't want anything to do with Lee, and they dump him off on the LAPD, who assign wisecracking Detective James Carter (Chris Tucker) to watch over him. Although Lee and Carter can't stand each other, they choose to work together to solve the case on their own when they figure out they've been ditched by both the FBI and police.

programme.title: 48 HRS.
programme.desc: Renegade cop Jack Cates (Nick Nolte) pulls bank robber Reggie Hammond (Eddie Murphy) from a federal prison on a 48-hour leave to help him capture Hammond's old partner, Albert Ganz (James Remar). Having escaped from a prison work crew, Ganz is on a killing spree around San Francisco, on the trail of half a million dollars that went missing after one of his robberies. The cocky Reggie knows where the money is, but spars with the hotheaded Jack as he enjoys his temporary freedom.

programme.title: True Grit
programme.desc: After an outlaw named Tom Chaney murders her father, feisty 14-year-old farm girl Mattie Ross hires Rooster Cogburn, a boozy, trigger-happy lawman, to help her find Chaney and avenge her father. The bickering duo are not alone in their quest, for a Texas Ranger named LaBoeuf is also tracking Chaney for reasons of his own. Together the unlikely trio ventures into hostile territory to dispense some Old West justice.

programme.title: Homestead
programme.desc: A former green beret and other survivors take refuge inside an elaborate compound when an attack on America leaves the world in chaos.

programme.title: Dexter: Resurrection
programme.desc: Dexter struggles as a new murderer puts the city on edge.

programme.title: Dunkirk
programme.desc: In May 1940, Germany advanced into France, trapping Allied troops on the beaches of Dunkirk. Under air and ground cover from British and French forces, troops were slowly and methodically evacuated from the beach using every serviceable naval and civilian vessel that could be found. At the end of this heroic mission, 330,000 French, British, Belgian and Dutch soldiers were safely evacuated.

programme.title: The Godfather
programme.desc: Widely regarded as one of the greatest films of all time, this mob drama, based on Mario Puzo's novel of the same name, focuses on the powerful Italian-American crime family of Don Vito Corleone (Marlon Brando). When the don's youngest son, Michael (Al Pacino), reluctantly joins the Mafia, he becomes involved in the inevitable cycle of violence and betrayal. Although Michael tries to maintain a normal relationship with his wife, Kay (Diane Keaton), he is drawn deeper into the family business.

programme.title: Internal Affairs
programme.desc: In the Los Angeles Police Department, Officer Dennis Peck (Richard Gere) is a divisive figure, loved by those who are loyal to him and looked on with suspicion by others. His disreputable behavior and dubious finances arouse the suspicion of Internal Affairs, and Sgt. Raymond Avila (Andy Garcia) and his partner (Laurie Metcalf) are assigned to investigate. When a series of witnesses are murdered, Avila realizes his life is in danger, along with that of his wife's (Nancy Travis).

programme.title: Reindeer Games
programme.desc: Just released from prison, all Rudy Duncan (Ben Affleck) wants is to start a new life with Ashley (Charlize Theron), the girl of his dreams, whom he met through pen pal letters in prison. But between them and happiness stands her crazy brother, Gabriel (Gary Sinise), and his motley crue of deadly criminals who think Rudy has some inside information about a casino where he once had a job -- a casino Gabriel and his short-fused posse plan to take down.

programme.title: The Hunt for Red October
programme.desc: Based on the popular Tom Clancy novel, this suspenseful movie tracks Soviet submarine captain Marko Ramius as he abandons his orders and heads for the east coast of the United States. Equipped with innovative stealth technology, Ramius' submarine, "Red October," is virtually invisible. However, when an American sub briefly detects the Russians' presence, CIA agent Jack Ryan sets out to determine Ramius' motives, fearing he may launch an attack on the U.S.

programme.title: Flight of the Intruder
programme.desc: U.S. Navy pilot Lt. Jake Grafton (Brad Johnson) and his bombardier buddy, Lt. Cmdr. Virgil Cole (Willem Dafoe), are two soldiers embedded in the Vietnam War growing frustrated by the military's constraints on their missions. Despite the best efforts of their commanding officer, Cmdr. Frank Camparelli (Danny Glover), to re-engage them, this disillusioned pair decide to take the war effort into their own hands with an explosive battle plan that could well get them court-martialed.

programme.title: The Brady Bunch Movie
programme.desc: The Bradys of the popular '70s sitcom get thrust into the '90s, with a whole new set of problems. The family's house is in danger of being taken away by developer Larry Dittmeyer if the ever-positive brood can't come up with $20,000. Parents Mike and Carol initially don't fret, until Mike has difficulty getting any of his architectural designs sold. Fearing the worst, the six Brady kids decide to enter a talent contest and raise the money themselves.

programme.title: Hugo
programme.desc: Orphaned and alone except for an uncle, Hugo Cabret lives in the walls of a train station in the 1930s Paris. Hugo's job is to oil and maintain the station's clocks, but to him, his more important task is to protect a broken automaton and notebook left to him by his late father. Accompanied by the goddaughter of an embittered toy merchant, Hugo embarks on a quest to solve the mystery of the automaton and find a place he can call home.

programme.title: Snoopy, Come Home
programme.desc: Charlie Brown's (Chad Webber) beloved dog Snoopy (Bill Melendez) receives a letter from his original owner, Lila (Johanna Baer), who has been sick in the hospital. With his bird friend Woodstock, Snoopy goes to visit Lila, making his way across the country despite seeing "no dogs allowed" signs everywhere. When Lila gets better, she asks Snoopy to live with her. After a farewell party, he sets out to live with Lila, leaving Charlie Brown depressed.

programme.title: Jimmy Neutron: Boy Genius
programme.desc: Jimmy Neutron: Boy Genius tells the simple story of a 10-year-old boy and his robot dog - battling evil, rescuing his parents, saving the Earth - and returning home in time for dinner. Jimmy's always inventing gadgets to make his life in Retroville more interesting. A boy genius with real kid emotions, Jimmy sometimes fantasizes about life on his own. But when the parents of Jimmy's hometown are kidnapped by invading aliens, he quickly discovers that things aren't so great when they're gone.

programme.title: Star Trek V: The Final Frontier
programme.desc: A renegade Vulcan makes Kirk (William Shatner), Spock (Leonard Nimoy), McCoy (DeForest Kelley) and the Enterprise go to a planet at the center of the galaxy.

programme.title: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: The four nations of Air, Water, Earth and Fire lived in harmony until the Fire Nation declared war. A century later, there is still no end in sight to the destruction, then, an Avatar named Aang (Noah Ringer) discovers that he has the power to control the four elements. He joins forces with Katara (Nicola Peltz), a Waterbender, and her brother, Sokka, to restore balance and harmony to their world.

programme.title: Beautiful Girls
programme.desc: An all-star cast sparks this captivating comedy about a group of old friends whose 10-year high school reunion creates some hilariously unexpected surprises. Willie (Timothy Hutton), Tommy (Matt Dillon), and Paul may have lost a bit of their youth, but they're still ready to party with Uma Thurman, Rosie O'Donnell, Lauren Holly, and Mira Sorvino -- the beautiful girls who've turned their lives upside down!

programme.title: Dinner for Schmucks
programme.desc: Tim (Paul Rudd) a rising executive, works for a boss who hosts a monthly event in which the guest who brings the biggest buffoon gets a career boost. Though he declines the invitation at first, he changes his mind when he meets Barry (Steve Carell), a man who builds dioramas using stuffed mice. The scheme backfires when Barry's blundering good intentions send Tim's life into a downward spiral, threatening a major business deal and possibly scuttling Tim's romantic relationship.

programme.title: Office Christmas Party
programme.desc: When the CEO (Jennifer Aniston) tries to close her hard-partying brother's (T.J. Miller) branch, he and his chief technical officer (Jason Bateman) must rally their co-workers and host an epic office Christmas party in an effort to impress a potential client and close a sale that will save their jobs.

programme.title: Se7en
programme.desc: When retiring police Detective William Somerset (Morgan Freeman) tackles a final case with the aid of newly transferred David Mills (Brad Pitt), they discover a number of elaborate and grizzly murders. They soon realize they are dealing with a serial killer (Kevin Spacey) who is targeting people he thinks represent one of the seven deadly sins. Somerset also befriends Mills' wife, Tracy (Gwyneth Paltrow), who is pregnant and afraid to raise her child in the crime-riddled city.

programme.title: Run & Gun
programme.desc: After leaving a life of crime and violence, reformed good guy Ray enjoys a quiet family life in the suburbs. However, Ray's past comes back to haunt him as he gets blackmailed into one last job to collect a mysterious package. After a deadly double-cross, he soon finds himself wounded and on the run from ruthless assassins who will stop at nothing to get what he has.

programme.title: John Grisham's The Rainmaker
programme.desc: Struggling new attorney Rudy Baylor (Matt Damon) resorts to working for a shady lawyer (Mickey Rourke), where he meets paralegal Deck Shifflet (Danny DeVito). When the insurance company of Dot Black (Mary Kay Place) refuses her dying son coverage, Baylor and Shifflet team up to fight the corrupt corporation, taking on its callous lawyer (Jon Voight). Meanwhile, Baylor becomes involved with Kelly Riker (Claire Danes), an abused wife, whose husband complicates matters when he confronts Baylor.

programme.title: Nine
programme.desc: Italian film director Guido Contini (Daniel Day-Lewis) grapples with epic crises in his personal and professional lives. At the same time, he must strike a balance of the demands of numerous women in his life, including his wife (Marion Cotillard), his mistress (Penélope Cruz), and his confidant (Judi Dench).

programme.title: Just Go With It
programme.desc: His heart recently broken, plastic surgeon Danny Maccabee (Adam Sandler) pretends to be married so he can enjoy future dates with no strings attached. His web of lies works, but when he meets Palmer (Brooklyn Decker) -- the gal of his dreams -- she resists involvement. Instead of coming clean, Danny enlists Katherine (Jennifer Aniston), his assistant, to pose as his soon-to-be-ex-wife. Instead of solving Danny's problems, the lies create more trouble.

programme.title: Shakespeare in Love
programme.desc: "Shakespeare in Love" is a romantic comedy for the 1990s set in the 1590s. It imaginatively unfolds the witty, sexy and timeless tale behind the creation of the greatest love story ever told. A young Shakespeare is out of cash and ideas; he meets his ideal woman and she inspires him to write one of his most famous plays.

programme.title: Baby Driver
programme.desc: Talented getaway driver Baby relies on the beat of his personal soundtrack to be the best in the game. After meeting the woman of his dreams, he sees a chance to ditch his shady lifestyle and make a clean break. Coerced into working for a crime boss, Baby must face the music as a doomed heist threatens his life, love and freedom.

programme.title: The Guilt Trip
programme.desc: Before embarking on a once-in-a-lifetime road trip, Andy Brewster pays a visit to his overbearing mother, Joyce. That proves to be a big mistake; Andy caves in under pressure to take his mom along for the ride. Early on -- as the miles roll by -- Andy feels nothing but aggravation at her antics. Eventually however, he comes to realize that they have more in common than he first thought and that Joyce's wisdom might be just what he needs.

programme.title: Spotlights: A Showtime Short Film Series
programme.desc: A collection of short films showcasing different themes.

programme.title: A Bad Moms Christmas
programme.desc: Under-appreciated and overburdened moms Amy, Kiki and Carla rebel against the challenges and expectations of the Super Bowl for moms: Christmas. As if creating the perfect holiday for their families isn't hard enough, they'll have to do it while hosting and entertaining their own respective mothers when they come to visit.

programme.title: She's Out of My League
programme.desc: Kirk (Jay Baruchel), an average guy stuck in a dead-end job, can't believe his luck when a gorgeous, successful woman named Molly (Alice Eve) falls in love with him. With no help from his stunned friends, relatives and ex-girlfriend, Kirk must figure out how to make this unlikely relationship work, even though he's the first to admit that Molly is way beyond him.

programme.title: The Wedding Singer
programme.desc: Set in 1985, Adam Sandler plays a nice guy with a broken heart who's stuck in one of the most romantic jobs in the world, a wedding singer. He loses all hope when he is abandoned at the altar by his fiancé. He meets a young woman named Julia, who enlists his help to plan her wedding. He falls in love with her and must win her over before she gets married.

programme.title: Jersey Girl
programme.desc: Ollie Trinke is young and at the top of his game as a music promoter. He is both a workaholic and a silver-tongued expert at manipulating the press. At a company Christmas party, Ollie meets Gertrude Steiney, a book editor for a New York publishing house. They are instantly attracted to each other, and begin a whirlwind romance that changes the course of his personal and professional life.

programme.title: Shall We Dance?
programme.desc: Despite having a great career and a loving family, lawyer John Clark (Richard Gere) is missing something in his life as he meanders listlessly from day to day. On his commute back home one night, Clark notices a stunning woman (Jennifer Lopez) in a dance studio and decides on a whim to join a class for ballroom dancing. While Clark finds a new spark in his life, his wife, Beverly (Susan Sarandon), grows suspicious of his frequent absences, since he decides to keep his dancing a secret.

programme.title: Postcards From Canada
programme.desc: Images of the East Coast and Canadian Winters.

programme.desc: The solution for chronic or acute back pain relief.

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: Josh hears that the bank robber that he's been trailing has been murdered.

programme.title: Dr. Ho Talks
programme.desc: Dr. Ho discusses getting relief from pain and tension in the comfort of one's home.

programme.title: Kaeshammer's Kitchen
programme.desc: The talented Nicolina, who wowed viewers on American Idol with her amazing voice that stops you in your tracks, is spicing up the kitchen before an awe-inspiring performance of her hit songs "You" and "Way Out.".

programme.title: The Lodger
programme.desc: When a landlady (Marie Ault) and her husband (Arthur Chesney) take in a new lodger (Ivor Novello), they're overjoyed: He's quiet, humble and pays a month's rent in advance. But his mysterious and suspicious behavior soon has them wondering if he's the killer terrorizing local blond girls. Their daughter, Daisy (June), a cocky model, is far less concerned, her attraction obvious. Her police-detective boyfriend (Malcolm Keen), in a pique of jealousy, seeks to uncover the lodger's true identity.

programme.title: Shadow of a Doubt
programme.desc: Uncle Charlie visits his relatives in Santa Rosa. He is a very charming man, but his niece slowly realizes that he is wanted for murder, and he soon recognizes her suspicions. Although one of the suspected murderers is killed and the case is considered closed, she still has her suspicions.

programme.title: Lost Horizon
programme.desc: Based on a novel by James Hilton, this fantastical drama follows a group of plane-crash survivors who have landed in the mythical Shangri-La, a valley hidden deep within the mountains of the Himalayas. Rescued by followers of the High Llama (Sam Jaffe), the outsiders grow to love the remote paradise, but British writer and diplomat Robert Conway (Ronald Colman), suspecting that the crash was no accident, begins to investigate, leading to a surprising revelation.

programme.title: Ferrari Challenge Europe 2026 - Trofeo Pirelli - Race 1 - Portimao
programme.desc: Ferrari Challenge a fost o parte integranta a lumii curselor timp de peste trei decenii. Astazi, seria monomarca a ,,Calutului Cabrat" se desfasoara in cinci regiuni diferite: Europa, America de Nord, Marea Britanie, Japonia si Australasia. Incepand cu anul 2026, EMPA este mandra sa va ofere intreaga lume a Ferrari Challenge Racing: peste 200 de piloti si aproape 100 de curse in cadrul a circa 30 de evenimente - de la Laguna Seca la Silverstone, de la Suzuka la Le Mans! Fiti martorii actiunii pe tot parcursul sezonului - din februarie si pana la punctul culminant stralucitor de la Finalele Mondiale!

programme.title: Highlights_Psccd26_Norisring
programme.desc: Porsche Carrera Racing scoate la iveala tot ce este mai bun din piloti, formand o prezenta globala redutabila in lumea seriilor monomarca. Porsche SIXT Carrera Cup Germania constituie unul dintre cele mai prestigioase campionate monomarca la nivel mondial, noul model 911 fiind introdus pentru anul 2026. Completata de campionatele de iarna Sprint Challenge Southern Europe (ianuarie-februarie) si de nou-infiintata Carrera World Cup din martie -- care reuneste cei mai buni piloti din toate cele 35 de campionate regionale -- aceasta reprezinta apogeul curselor Porsche. Mai mult decat o rampa de lansare pentru talentele emergente, Carrera Cup este, prin natura sa, un camp de lupta captivant.

programme.title: Fastzone 2026
programme.desc: FastZone - Actualizarea saptamanala a motorsportului Actualizarea ta saptamanala despre motorsport este distilata intr-un program de o jumatate de ora. Acoperind totul, de la prototipuri la curse de anduranta, karting la avioane si chiar si unele ciudatenii reale... FastZone combina traditia si o perspectiva proaspata asupra motorsportului, devenind sursa ta suprema pentru tot ce este rapid si fascinant!

programme.title: Gp Confidential 2026
programme.desc: GP Confidential - Accesul tau complet in Formula 1 Descopera secretele din spatele strategiilor de succes in F1 cu GP Confidential! In 25 de episoade captivante, imbunatatite cu animatii 3D de ultima generatie, patrundem in detaliile tehnice care determina care echipe triumfa in conformitate cu regulile si care esueaza. Dincolo de aceste analize detaliate, prezentam momente de neuitat din istoria F1 si oferim previzualizari palpitante ale curselor. Pentru fiecare pasionat de F1, GP Confidential este o experienta de neratat. Descopera Formula 1 asa cum nu ai mai vazut-o pana acum cu GP Confidential!

programme.title: Dtm 2026 - Race 1 - Oschersleben
programme.desc: DTM. Aici respira traditia motorsportului. Intrat in cel de-al 42-lea sezon, DTM reprezinta motorsportul pur: combina o fascinatie si o familiaritate unice cu o dinamica inconfundabila!Nu mai putin de noua producatori diferiti (Lamborghini, Ferrari, BMW, Mercedes, Porsche, McLaren, Audi, Ford si Aston Martin) si noua piloti diferiti care intra in ultimul weekend cu sanse la titlu... Diversitatea si echilibrul competitiv transforma fiecare weekend DTM intr-un spectacol!Sustinut de un pachet complet de competitii suport, ce include ADAC GT Masters, GT4 Germany si nu numai - pachetul DTM imbina mostenirea istorica cu o forta remarcabila si un nucleu tanar!

programme.title: Adac Gt4 2026 - Race 1 - Oschersleben
programme.desc: Piatra de temelie a curselor GT, ADAC GT Masters si-a creat o identitate puternica in universul DTM.Combinand tinere talente dornice sa se afirme cu nume consacrate, totul sub un regulament inteligent si competitiv, GT Masters ofera mixul suprem intre experienta si ambitie - la volanul unor masini GT care scot flacari.Desfasurandu-se alaturi de DTM in cadrul a patru etape, ADAC GT Masters este un element esential pentru acoperirea voastra media din weekend. Viitori campioni si curse spectaculoase pe marea scena a categoriei GT.Ignorati ADAC GT Masters pe propriul risc!

When Andie and Ben meet, their plans backfire.

programme.title: The Wedding Date
programme.desc: With the wedding of her younger sister (Amy Adams) fast approaching, Kat Ellis (Debra Messing) faces the undesirable prospect of traveling alone to London for the ceremony. While this is bad enough, Jeffrey (Jeremy Sheffield), the man who left her as they moved closer to marriage, happens to be the groom's best man. Determined to show everyone -- most of all Jeffrey -- that her romantic life is as full and thrilling as ever, Kat hires a charming male escort (Dermot Mulroney) as her date.

programme.title: No Strings Attached
programme.desc: Lifelong friends Emma (Natalie Portman) and Adam (Ashton Kutcher) take their relationship to the next level by having sex. Afraid of ruining their friendship, the new lovers make a pact to keep things purely physical, with no fighting, no jealousy and no expectations. Emma and Adam pledge to do whatever they want, wherever they want, as long as they do not fall in love. The question then becomes: Who will fall first?

programme.title: Lay the Favorite
programme.desc: A former stripper's (Rebecca Hall) talent with numbers lands her a job with a professional gambler (Bruce Willis) who runs a sports book in Las Vegas.

programme.title: Small Time
programme.desc: A young man (Devon Bostick) decides to skip college and join his father (Christopher Meloni) as a used-car salesman.

programme.title: How to Lose a Guy in 10 Days
programme.desc: An advice columnist, Andie Anderson (Kate Hudson), tries pushing the boundaries of what she can write about in her new piece about how to get a man to leave you in 10 days. Her editor, Lana (Bebe Neuwirth), loves it, and Andie goes off to find a man she can use for the experiment. Enter executive Ben Berry (Matthew McConaughey), who is so confident in his romantic prowess that he thinks he can make any woman fall in love with him in 10 days. When Andie and Ben meet, their plans backfire.

programme.title: Three Women
programme.desc: Maggie summons the courage to tell her parents and the police about the relationship with her high school teacher.

programme.title: Leap Year
programme.desc: When yet another anniversary passes without a marriage proposal from her boyfriend, Anna (Amy Adams) decides to take action. Aware of a Celtic tradition that allows women to pop the question on Feb. 29, she plans to follow her lover to Dublin and ask him to marry her. Fate has other plans, however, and Anna winds up on the other side of the Emerald Isle with handsome, but surly, Declan -- an Irishman who may just lead Anna down the road to true love.

programme.title: Hot Fuzz
programme.desc: As a former London constable, Nicholas Angel (Simon Pegg) finds it difficult to adapt to his new assignment in the sleepy British village of Sandford. Not only does he miss the excitement of the big city, but he also has a well-meaning oaf (Nick Frost) for a partner. However, when a series of grisly accidents rocks Sandford, Nick smells something rotten in the idyllic village.

programme.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
programme.desc: When Tony Stark (Robert Downey Jr.) jump-starts a dormant peacekeeping program, things go terribly awry, forcing him, Thor (Chris Hemsworth), the Incredible Hulk (Mark Ruffalo) and the rest of the Avengers to reassemble. As the fate of Earth hangs in the balance, the team is put to the ultimate test as they battle Ultron, a technological terror hell-bent on human extinction. Along the way, they encounter two mysterious and powerful newcomers, Pietro and Wanda Maximoff.

programme.title: The Vow
programme.desc: Paige and Leo are happily married newlyweds, but their idyllic life together suddenly shatters when a car accident leaves her in a coma. When Paige awakes, she has severe memory loss and doesn't know Leo. She also has a confusing relationship with her parents and still harbors feelings for a former fiance. Despite these difficult obstacles, Leo is determined to renew their bond and rebuild their marriage.

programme.title: Failure to Launch
programme.desc: A young man (Matthew McConaughey) continues to live at the home of parents who, in desperation to push him out of the nest once and for all, hatch a plan. They hire a beautiful woman (Sarah Jessica Parker) to entice him to assume the mantle of responsibility and get his own place.

programme.title: Pixels
programme.desc: When aliens intercept video feeds of classic arcade games and misinterpret them as a declaration of war, they attack Earth, using the games as models. Knowing that he must employ a similar strategy, President Will Cooper (Kevin James) recruits his childhood pal, former video-game champ and home-theater installer Sam Brenner (Adam Sandler), to lead a team of old-school arcade players and a military specialist (Michelle Monaghan) in an all-out battle to save the planet.

programme.title: The 40 Year-Old Virgin
programme.desc: Three dysfunctional co-workers embark on a mission to help their newfound friend lose his sexual innocence.

programme.title: Black Nativity
programme.desc: Langston (Jacob Latimore), a Baltimore teen raised by a single mother (Jennifer Hudson), travels to New York City to spend the Christmas holiday with estranged relatives, the Rev. Cornell Cobbs (Forest Whitaker) and his wife, Aretha (Angela Bassett). However, Langston soon finds that Cobbs has strict rules, and the youth is unwilling to follow them. Instead, he sets out on a return journey to his mother and finds the value of faith, healing and family along the way.

programme.title: Trainwreck
programme.desc: Ever since her father drilled into her head that monogamy isn't realistic, magazine writer Amy has made promiscuity her credo. As much as she enjoys an uninhibited life free of commitment, Amy is really in a rut. While writing a profile about charming and successful sports doctor Aaron Conners, she finds herself actually falling in love for the first time, and what's more, Aaron seems to like her too. Amy starts to wonder if it's time to clean up her act.

programme.title: Pixels
programme.desc: When aliens intercept video feeds of classic arcade games and misinterpret them as a declaration of war, they attack Earth, using the games as models. Knowing that he must employ a similar strategy, President Will Cooper (Kevin James) recruits his childhood pal, former video-game champ and home-theater installer Sam Brenner (Adam Sandler), to lead a team of old-school arcade players and a military specialist (Michelle Monaghan) in an all-out battle to save the planet.

programme.title: Inside Man
programme.desc: A tough detective matches wits with a bank robber, while an enigmatic woman has her own agenda.

programme.title: Dinocroc vs. Supergator
programme.desc: A biotech company creates two gigantic reptiles in a secret island laboratory. When the massive creatures escape, an undercover investigator, a Fish and Game officer and a swamp hunter team up to track down and kill the beasts.

programme.title: The Longest Yard
programme.desc: Disgraced pro football quarterback Paul Crewe (Adam Sandler) lands in jail, where manipulative Warden Hazen (James Cromwell) recruits him to advise the institution's team. This turns into a lead role quarterbacking a crew of inmates in a game against a team of prison guards. Aided by incarcerated ex-NFL coach Nate Scarborough (Burt Reynolds), Crewe and his team must overcome not only the bloodthirstiness of the opposition, but also the corrupt officials trying to fix the game against them.

programme.title: Dead Heat
programme.desc: Boston cop Pally (Kiefer Sutherland) is forced into early retirement, putting a strain on his marriage. Pally's stepbrother, Ray (Anthony LaPaglia), attempts to lift his spirits by tipping him off to a sure-bet racehorse. But their attempts to secure the champion equine are thwarted by a local mob boss (Daniel Benzali), who steals the horse as repayment for a gambling debt. With their investment on the line, Pally and Ray become entangled in a web of underworld crime and murder.

programme.title: Star Wars: The Force Awakens
programme.desc: Thirty years after the defeat of the Galactic Empire, the galaxy faces a new threat from the evil Kylo Ren (Adam Driver) and the First Order. When a defector named Finn crash-lands on a desert planet, he meets Rey (Daisy Ridley), a tough scavenger whose droid contains a top-secret map. Together, the young duo joins forces with Han Solo (Harrison Ford) to make sure the Resistance receives the intelligence concerning the whereabouts of Luke Skywalker (Mark Hamill), the last of the Jedi knights.

programme.title: Ground Control
programme.desc: An air-traffic controller (Kiefer Sutherland) quits after a plane crash but, years later, goes to help an airport that is in the path of a terrible storm.

programme.title: Paper Soldiers
programme.desc: A rookie thief receives on-the-job training from a crew of bungling burglars.

programme.title: Motives
programme.desc: A successful businessman (Shemar Moore) gets caught in a web of deceit after cheating on his wife (Vivica A. Fox).

programme.title: Motives 2: Retribution
programme.desc: A man (Brian J. White) cuts through lies and deceit to investigate the murder of his imprisoned brother (Shemar Moore).

programme.title: How High
programme.desc: Multi-platinum rap superstars Redman and Method Man star as Jamal and Silas, two regular guys who smoke something magical, ace their college entrance exams and wind up at Harvard. Ivy League ways are strange but Silas and Jamal take it in a stride -- until their supply of supernatural smoke runs dry. That's when they have to start living by their wits and rely on their natural resources to make the grade.

programme.title: The Last Face
programme.desc: Miguel (Javier Bardem), a Spanish doctor, puts himself in harm's way to deliver medical treatment to the victims of military uprisings. Wren (Charlize Theron) is the spokesperson for an organization that funds medical assistance for impoverished nations the world over. They meet in Liberia, where Wren is immediately impressed with Miguel's selflessness, medical skill and charm. They begin a torrid affair, one they must learn to balance with their important work.

programme.title: Motives
programme.desc: A successful businessman (Shemar Moore) gets caught in a web of deceit after cheating on his wife (Vivica A. Fox).

programme.title: Tucker: The Man and His Dream
programme.desc: Obsessed with cars since childhood, inventor Preston Tucker (Jeff Bridges) has his first successful auto design partnership in the 1930s and designs a successful gun turret for World War II use. With those achievements under his belt, Tucker is determined to create a futuristic car for the masses: the Tucker Torpedo. However, his dreams are challenged by Detroit's auto manufacturers, production problems and accusations of stock fraud, and he is forced to defend his dream and honesty in court.

programme.title: Mindhunters
programme.desc: FBI agent Jake Harris (Val Kilmer) escorts a group of cadets to a remote island for simulation training. The cadets, under the leadership of J.D. (Christian Slater), will try to catch an imaginary serial killer within the island's elaborate facility. The FBI, however, is suspicious of Harris' methods and dispatch Gabe Jensen (LL Cool J) to act as an outside observer. What he finds is a simulation exercise that becomes dangerously real and training that becomes a fight for survival.

programme.title: Miss Julie
programme.desc: A baron's frustrated daughter (Jessica Chastain) courts scandal and more when she tries to seduce her father's valet (Colin Farrell).

programme.title: Speak No Evil
programme.desc: A dream holiday turns into a living nightmare when an American couple and their daughter spend the weekend at a British family's idyllic country estate.

programme.title: Tucker: The Man and His Dream
programme.desc: Obsessed with cars since childhood, inventor Preston Tucker (Jeff Bridges) has his first successful auto design partnership in the 1930s and designs a successful gun turret for World War II use. With those achievements under his belt, Tucker is determined to create a futuristic car for the masses: the Tucker Torpedo. However, his dreams are challenged by Detroit's auto manufacturers, production problems and accusations of stock fraud, and he is forced to defend his dream and honesty in court.

programme.title: Sea Level 3: Dolphin Boy
programme.desc: A little boy survives a plane crash and is rescued by a young wild dolphin. They grow up together, entertaining marine life with their funny tricks. One day, the peace of their joyful world is destroyed by an evil octopus.

programme.title: Tracks
programme.desc: Accompanied only by her faithful dog and four camels, an Australian (Mia Wasikowska) satisfies her craving for solitude by embarking on a solo trip across the desert from Alice Springs to the Indian Ocean.

programme.title: Bandslam
programme.desc: A gifted singer/songwriter, Charlotte hires Will Burton, a new guy in town, to manage her fledgling rock band. She wants one thing from him: to help her win a contest against her ex-boyfriend in an upcoming battle of the bands. Charlotte's band comes together and seems to have a real shot at victory, while Will and dynamic guitarist Sa5m begin to make some beautiful music of their own.

programme.title: H Is for Happiness
programme.desc: An optimistic 12-year-old girl hatches scheme after scheme to make her mother, father and uncle happy again.

programme.title: Sea Level
programme.desc: When poachers steal dozens of egg sacks from his reef, bamboo shark Pup makes it his personal mission to save his unhatched brothers and sisters. His rescue mission takes him above water into the world of man.

programme.title: Sea Level 2: Magic Arch
programme.desc: A young dolphin with an active imagination discovers a magic arch that makes wishes come true. However, when its enemies use the arch to become big and strong, it must find a way to stop them.

programme.title: Sea Level 3: Dolphin Boy
programme.desc: A little boy survives a plane crash and is rescued by a young wild dolphin. They grow up together, entertaining marine life with their funny tricks. One day, the peace of their joyful world is destroyed by an evil octopus.

programme.title: Bells of Coronado
programme.desc: An insurance agent investigating a mine owner's death is pitted against foreign agents and uranium smugglers.

programme.title: Vengeance Valley
programme.desc: Adopted by the wealthy rancher Arch Strobie, orphan Owen Daybright (Burt Lancaster) grows to be a respectable foreman on Strobie's ranch. Strobie's natural son, Lee (Robert Walker), is jealous of Owen and finally finds a way to undermine his upstanding brother. When Lee conceives an illegitimate child with Lily Fasken (Sally Forrest), who refuses to name him as the father, he tells her revenge-minded brothers that Owen is to blame, hoping they'll take his half-brother out of the picture.

programme.title: Oklahoma Annie
programme.desc: Judy Canova (Judy Canova) is a capable cowgirl and a sassy shopkeeper in her frontier town. But, once she spies the dashing new town sheriff, Dan Fraser (John Russell), Judy decides to branch out into catching crooks to garner his notice. With her daring behavior and bravery, she soon earns a deputy's badge, allowing her to spend time with her favorite lawman. But, when Dan is abducted by a band of wild outlaws, it's up to Judy to round up a posse and save the day.

programme.title: Massacre
programme.desc: A tribe of hostile Native Americans goes on the warpath, slaughtering white men with guns sold to them by mercenary outlaws.

programme.title: Pancho Villa
programme.desc: This mostly fictional account follows the trigger-happy Mexican revolutionary Pancho Villa (Telly Savalas) in his attempt to kill bitter nemesis Gen. Goyo and overthrow Mexico's government. The violent endeavor brings Villa north to New Mexico, where he battles a group of determined American soldiers led by the no-nonsense Col. Wilcox (Chuck Connors), and endures unanticipated mishaps and bad fortune, including a double-cross by his friend and partner, Scotty (Clint Walker).

programme.title: Boss
programme.desc: Two ex-slave bounty hunters (Fred Williamson, D'Urville Martin) take care of business in a lawless Wild West town.

programme.title: Lawman
programme.desc: The marshal tries to save his deputy from a trap laid by a killer.

programme.title: Tales of Wells Fargo
programme.desc: While pursuing a bandit, Jim runs into his friend and fellow agent Ben Wilson, who awaits his fiancée, Ellen Stevens, but when Ellen's stagecoach arrives, Jim learns the bandit tried to rob it and realizes Ellen holds the key to finding him.

programme.title: The Blue Elephant
programme.desc: A young, carefree elephant (Thomas Sharkey) becomes separated from his herd and seeks help from new friends.

programme.title: Cricket & Antoinette
programme.desc: Cricket and Antoinette represent two separate worlds, the world of noise, chaos and creativity, and the world of work, order and discipline; as they fall in love, in spite of obvious differences, they manage to create harmony.

programme.title: The Snow Queen 2
programme.desc: After the trolls' victory over the Snow Queen, Orm claims that he is destined to marry the princess and inherit great power.

programme.title: Let Us In
programme.desc: A 12-year-old girl is determined to uncover who or what is behind the rash of disappearances occurring in her small town.

programme.title: The Blue Elephant
programme.desc: A young, carefree elephant (Thomas Sharkey) becomes separated from his herd and seeks help from new friends.

programme.title: A Mermaid's Tale
programme.desc: Twelve-year-old Ryan is despondent about moving to a dying seacoast village until she forms an unlikely friendship with a quirky teenage mermaid.

programme.title: Cricket & Antoinette
programme.desc: Cricket and Antoinette represent two separate worlds, the world of noise, chaos and creativity, and the world of work, order and discipline; as they fall in love, in spite of obvious differences, they manage to create harmony.

programme.title: Oddball
programme.desc: A chicken farmer and his granddaughter train a dog to protect a penguin sanctuary from foxes.

programme.title: The Andy Griffith Show
programme.desc: Two fun-loving girls from Mount Pilot interrupt Andy and Barney, who are working late doing inventory. They end up in hot water when Helen and Thelma Lou see them with the other girls.

programme.title: The Andy Griffith Show
programme.desc: Aunt Bee feels unneeded when Malcolm Merriweather returns to Mayberry and gets enlisted to help at the Taylor House to give Aunt Bee a break from work.

programme.title: The Andy Griffith Show
programme.desc: Barney sees Andy and Helen sneaking a kiss in the jewelry store and tells everyone they are engaged. Aunt Bee redecorates Andy's room to make it more appropriate for a bride and throws a surprise party for them.

programme.title: The Andy Griffith Show
programme.desc: Thelma Lou uses Gomer and flirts with him to make Barney jealous after he says that he has her in his hip pocket. Things escalate when she slips and kisses Gomer on the cheek.

programme.title: The Andy Griffith Show
programme.desc: Andy, Barney, and Gomer take Opie and a couple of his friends on a camping trip. When Opie leaves early in the morning to pick berries, Barney and Gomer go looking for him but end up getting lost in the woods.

programme.title: The Andy Griffith Show
programme.desc: Gomer enlists and joins the Marines to test himself as a man, with Andy driving him to the base for his first day at boot camp. When Andy learns that the sergeant plans to get Gomer home, he tries to prevent Gomer from getting kicked out.

programme.title: Total Recall
programme.desc: Douglas Quaid is a bored construction worker in the year 2084 who dreams of visiting colonized Mars. He visits "Rekall," a company that plants false memories into people's brains, in order to experience the thrill of Mars without having to travel there. But something goes wrong during the procedure; Quaid discovers that his entire life is actually a false memory and that the people who implanted it in his head now want him dead.

programme.title: The Running Man
programme.desc: In the year 2019, America is a totalitarian state where the favorite television program is "The Running Man" -- a game show in which prisoners must run to freedom to avoid a brutal death. Having been made a scapegoat by the government, an imprisoned Ben Richards (Arnold Schwarzenegger) has the opportunity to make it back to the outside again by being a contestant on the deadly show, although the twisted host, Damon Killian (Richard Dawson), has no intention of letting him escape.

programme.title: Heartbreak Ridge
programme.desc: Marine Sgt. Thomas Highway (Clint Eastwood) is a decorated veteran of two wars. On his last posting before retirement, he is surrounded by officers with no combat experience who view him as an odd, even dangerous, holdover. Highway is assigned to train a group of undisciplined recruits including Cpl. Stitch Jones (Mario Van Peebles), a slick hustler who has previously encountered Highway. As the old soldier prepares his men for a war they don't believe will come, the U.S. invades Grenada.

programme.title: My Life Without Me
programme.desc: When hard-working mother of two Ann (Sarah Polley) discovers she has terminal ovarian cancer and the doctors give her two months to live, she decides to keep the news from her family. Passing off her increasing weakness as a mild case of anemia, Ann begins to put her priorities in order in preparation for the last few months of her life. She records birthday messages for her daughters, visits her estranged father in prison and even seeks a replacement wife for her husband, Lee (Mark Ruffalo).

programme.title: Dangerous
programme.desc: An ex-con and reformed sociopath battles a band of heavily armed mercenaries as he tries to uncover the truth behind his brother's mysterious death.

programme.title: Selma
programme.desc: Although the Civil Rights Act of 1964 legally desegregated the South, discrimination was still rampant in certain areas, making it very difficult for Blacks to register to vote. In 1965, an Alabama city became the battleground in the fight for suffrage. Despite violent opposition, Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. (David Oyelowo) and his followers pressed forward on an epic march from Selma to Montgomery, and their efforts culminated with President Lyndon Johnson signing the Voting Rights Act of 1965.

When Tracy runs for school president, Jim feels that she will be a poor influence on the student body and convinces Paul, a dim-witted but popular student athlete, to run against Tracy. When she becomes aware of Jim's secret involvement in the race, a bitter feud is sparked.

programme.title: Sugarcreek Amish Mysteries: Blessings in Disguise
programme.desc: After Cheryl's three-year engagement ends in a devastating breakup, her life is turned upside down when her aunt offers her an escape from Chicago to the Amish town of Sugarcreek. Struggling with being a fish out of water, Cheryl uncovers an unsettling secret that could disrupt the small town of Ohio. As Cheryl begins to solve the mystery, she finds community, belonging and the potential of new love.

programme.title: Morning Show Mystery: Mortal Mishaps
programme.desc: Billie Blessings has gone from beloved chef, restaurant owner and morning show segment host to the prime suspect in a murder case when one of the executives at the network dies from poisoning.

programme.title: Morning Show Mysteries: Murder on the Menu
programme.desc: Beloved cooking show host Billie Blessings finds herself in hot water when a dead body turns up in the car of one of her guests.

programme.title: Morning Show Mysteries: A Murder in Mind
programme.desc: Cookbook author Billie Blessings is excited when friend Katie Sanders appears as a guest host on her show, but being a TV star can't save Katie from falling under suspicion of murder.

programme.title: Morning Show Mysteries: Countdown to Murder
programme.desc: The murder of a supermarket owner puts TV chef Billie Blessings and Detective Ian Jackson on the trail of a possible serial killer.

programme.title: Morning Show Mysteries: Death by Design
programme.desc: A woman's twin sister is found strangled to death.

programme.title: Morning Show Mysteries: Murder Ever After
programme.desc: TV host Billie Blessings finds bones in the basement of an old friend's house, unearthing a dark secret that threatens to unravel the lives of the most powerful people in the city.

programme.title: Longing
programme.desc: Daniel, riche célibataire d'une soixantaine d'années, apprend qu'une ancienne petite amie a donné naissance à un enfant il y a 20 ans et que son fils vient de mourir. Daniel explore la vie de son fils décédé, apprenant à le connaître par procuration à travers ses proches, et il réévalue ses choix de vie.

programme.title: Par amour
programme.desc: Sarah et Antoine, débordés par le travail et leurs deux enfants, sont au bord de la rupture ; un jour, Simon, leur fils aîné, confie à sa mère qu'il entend des voix ; tandis qu'Antoine peine à comprendre la gravité de la situation, Sarah décide de soutenir son fils coûte que coûte ; jusqu'où sera-t-elle prête à aller, par amour ?

programme.title: Tel père tel fils
programme.desc: La vie d'Eli commence à s'effondrer alors que son père meurtrier attend son sort dans le couloir de la mort. Découvrant des déclencheurs similaires en lui-même, il prend bientôt des mesures extrêmes pour s'assurer que la série de sauvageries de sa famille prenne fin.

programme.title: Transformers un
programme.desc: L'histoire d'origine inédite d'Optimus Prime et Megatron, mieux connus comme des ennemis jurés, mais autrefois amis liés comme des frères, qui ont changé le destin de Cybertron à jamais.

programme.title: Les Furies
programme.desc: Waterloo aura désormais son équipe de hockey semi-pro masculine expulsant ainsi les ligues féminines amateurs de l'aréna. Pour venger leur temps de glace perdu, une joueuse de hockey impulsive et une impitoyable octogénaire, ancienne championne de derby, ont un plan: recruter les laissées pour compte de la ville et mettre sur pied une équipe de roller derby clandestine. Avec la complicité du Cercle de fermières, elles prouveront que le sport féminin peut aussi soulever les foules.

programme.title: Narco Hunters
programme.desc: Lorsqu'un jeune Américain meurt d'une surdose de fentanyl au Mexique, l'ex-espion Abraham Woodhill est chargé de la mission d'anéantir les cartels responsables. Avec l'aide de l'ex-agent détenu Jake Byrne, l'infâme White Devil, il déclenche une violente opération capitale à travers les villages, la jungle et les retranchements des cartels.

programme.title: Mille secrets, mille dangers
programme.desc: Alain se marie avec Virginie. La journée sera grandiose, la journée sera parfaite et les tantes libanaises d'Alain parleront de cette noce pour des années à venir. Cependant, Alain a mal au ventre. Une colère sourde gronde en lui. Il craint les retrouvailles de ses parents dont le divorce orageux a troublé son enfance. Il craint le retour en force de ses crises d'anxiété, il craint sa dépendance aux médicaments dans laquelle il est sur le point de retomber.

programme.title: Space Cadet: l'odyssée de Céleste
programme.desc: Une jeune astronaute et son robot gardien explorent le chagrin, la perte et l'amour à travers les générations.

programme.title: Choc
programme.desc: Après une confrontation avec son père éloigné, le jeune écrivain Ashish, surnommé Ash, découvre un secret qui le contraint à jongler entre la famille, l'amour et le succès, tout en naviguant entre la vie urbaine excitante qu'il désire et sa réalité de banlieusard.

programme.title: Je suis toujours là
programme.desc: Rio de Janeiro, 1971, sous la dictature militaire. La grande maison des Paiva, près de la plage, est un havre de vie, de paroles partagées, de jeux, de rencontres. Jusqu'au jour où des hommes du régime viennent arrêter Rubens, le père de famille, qui disparaît sans laisser de traces. Sa femme Eunice et ses cinq enfants mèneront alors un combat acharné pour la recherche de la vérité.

programme.title: Dans la peau de Cyrano

Her younger sister, Suzanne, is a former beauty queen who is long on charm but a bit slow on the uptake. Their associates are Mary Jo Shively, a recent divorcee, and officer manager Charlene Frazier, whose sweetness is matched only by her naivete. Their deliverman is Anthony Bouvier, a well-spoken ex-convict, and cheerfully dotty senior citizen Bernice Clifton often drops by for a visit as well.

programme.title: Vintage Mecanic
programme.desc: François Allain a mis la main sur une Ferrari 456 M GT, une youngtimer italienne avec son mythique moteur V12. Un travail colossal attend l'expert automobile : dépose du moteur/boîte pour accéder au treillis avant, révision complète du moteur incluant l'embrayage, la distribution et l'allumage, sans oublier un gros travail sur la boîte de vitesses manuelle. Une fois chaque pièce restaurée, il faudra tout remonter.

programme.title: Vintage Mecanic
programme.desc: François Allain a dégoté une perle rare, une Porsche 911 964 jubilée. Côté mécanique, il faut prévoir une révision moteur, une remise en route et un nettoyage par vaporisation de gaz carbonique, sans oublier une inspection détaillée de la partie double allumage, spécificité incontournable de la type 964. Pour la carrosserie, François va s'attaquer à une peinture complète, exigeant rigueur et précision.

programme.title: Vintage Mecanic
programme.desc: Conçu pour transporter plus de 30 personnes et avaler les kilomètres, le Delahaye Type 163 était un symbole haut de gamme du transport collectif. Seul petit contretemps : le véhicule qu'a déniché François n'a pas de moteur. Le châssis a subi les assauts du temps et est rongé par la rouille. Freinage, transmission, faisceau électrique : tout est à revoir. Et comme si cela ne suffisait pas, François s'est fixé un objectif ambitieux : partager ce patrimoine avec la jeune génération.

programme.title: Vintage Mecanic
programme.desc: La Mercedes SLK 200K, véritable icône des années 90, fait son entrée dans le garage de François. Celui-ci a mis la main sur cette youngtimer au design intemporel, qui marque l'histoire des cabriolets avec son emblématique toit rigide escamotable. Moteur, freinage et trains roulants seront passés au crible pour assurer un retour sans faille à la fiabilité d'origine.

programme.title: Wheeler Dealers France
programme.desc: Gerry et Aurélien se lancent dans la rénovation du break le plus puissant au monde dans les années 2000, la mythique Audi RS6. Les deux hommes vont tâcher de la rendre plus puissante qu'à l'origine. Leur objectif : atteindre les 600 chevaux grâce à une préparation moteur et un gros travail sur les turbos du V8.

programme.title: Wheeler Dealers France
programme.desc: Gerry et Aurélien se lancent dans la restauration d'un youngtimer français qui a marqué toute une génération, la Citroën BX Sport. Produite à seulement 7562 exemplaires, cette voiture est devenue 35 ans après sa sortie un véritable collector, grâce à son design particulier et une technologie novatrice pour l'époque. Aurélien et Gerry vont devoir mettre les mains dans le cambouis.

programme.title: V6
programme.desc: Cap sur l'Italie chez Maserati ! Thomas pousse les portes du Musée Panini où sont entreposées les plus beaux exemplaires du patrimoine de la marque et fait un tour à l'usine. Avant de retrouver Anthony pour un double essai de rêve : MC20 et GranTurismo !

programme.title: Les grandes heures de l'automobile anglaise
programme.desc: Le Tone explore les icônes automobiles du Royaume-Uni, des luxueuses Rolls Royce aux sportives Aston Martin, en passant par des modèles emblématiques tels que la Mini Austin de Mr Bean, la Jaguar Type E et le précurseur des SUV modernes, le Range Rover de 1970. Un voyage à travers l'histoire britannique de l'automobile.

programme.title: Fernando
programme.desc: Le quotidien pendant la pandémie. Pour la première fois de sa vie, Fernando doit passer plusieurs semaines à la maison et continuer seul sa préparation physique et technique (à l'aide d'un simulateur installé chez lui). C'est en plein confinement qu'il conclut son contrat avec Renault. Après avoir annoncé son retour, il se concentre sur l'Indy 500.

programme.title: Wheels and Waves
programme.desc: Wheels and Waves est un festival qui s'étend sur cinq jours à Biarritz, dans le Pays Basque, et qui mêle moto et sports de glisse.

programme.title: V6
programme.desc: Anthony Beltoise et Thomas de la chaîne Youtube WorldSupercars vous emmènent dans l'univers des marques automobiles les plus sportives. Essais de supercars, visite chez le constructeur, tests des versions de course : les passionnés apprécieront ! Au menu de cette nouvelle saison : Lamborghini, Maserati, Ferrari, Aston Martin et Alpine : que du lourd !

programme.title: Thorn Bikes, l'atelier Moto
programme.desc: Aucun membre de l'équipe n'ayant jamais mis une moto lourde et/ou très puissante dans le sable, l'équipe fait venir quelques experts en la matière.

programme.title: Thorn Bikes, l'atelier Moto
programme.desc: Les experts sont formels : les machines surpuissantes pensées pour l'asphalte ne parcourront pas un mètre dans le sable si on ne modifie pas radicalement les partie-cycles.

programme.title: Thorn Bikes, l'atelier Moto
programme.desc: Rien ne vaut un essai en conditions réelles pour se familiariser avec cet environnement hostile. Direction le Bud Racing Training Camp, un terrain spécialement conçu pour l'entrainement des pilotes dans le sable.

programme.desc: Art Burke retourne à Winnipeg après une première livraison couronnée de succès mais il percute un banc de neige et son camion s'embourbe dangereusement.

programme.title: Le convoi de l'extrême : le grand frisson
programme.desc: A Winnipeg, Mark Kohaykewych, patron de Polar Industries, constate dès le mois de février les conséquences d'un réchauffement précoce. Darrell Ward et Lisa Kelly subissent aussi les mauvaises conditions météorologiques, qui pourraient causer la faillite de leur société. Todd se rend à Pikangikum pour livrer des matériaux de construction et doit franchir un lac gelé de 16 mètres alors que Darrell honore son premier contrat et se rend à Garden Hill.

programme.title: Le convoi de l'extrême : le grand frisson
programme.desc: En chemin pour Pikangikum, Darrell apprend qu'une partie de la route menant à sa destination vient d'être fermée, à cause de la hausse des températures. Art est de nouveau sur les routes et doit rejoindre St Theresa Point pour livrer sa cargaison de matériaux de construction. Lisa est chanceuse car elle rentre à Winnipeg avec un chargement mais elle rencontre aussi quelques difficultés.

programme.title: Le convoi de l'extrême : le grand frisson
programme.desc: Darrell vient de décrocher un nouveau contrat à Fort Chipewyan. Avec Lisa, ils vont livrer 50 tonnes de matériel de chauffage et se lancent, pour la première fois, sur des routes les plus reculées de Winnipeg. Steph se prépare pour son premier trajet où elle sera accompagnée de Todd Dewey, le meilleur chauffeur de Polar Industries, pour se rendre à Shamattawa. Art reprend le même chemin que l'année précédente, où il avait failli perdre la vie, pour effectuer sa livraison à Sachigo Lake.

programme.title: Le convoi de l'extrême : le grand frisson
programme.desc: Le grand lac gelé étant interdit d'accès par les autorités, Todd et Steph sont bloqués. De son côté, Mark a décroché un contrat pour une livraison hors norme. Il envoie Alex jusqu'à St Theresa Point pour acheminer son chargement. Darrell affronte une épreuve de taille : il transporte une cargaison avec une importante quantité de fioul et doit aller à Elk Island Lodge en empruntant une route qui n'est pas gérée par les autorités locales.

programme.title: Everton / Coventry City
programme.desc: A découvrir les plus belles affiches de la prestigieuse Premier League, le championnat d'Angleterre de football. C'est le championnat le plus regardé dans le monde. Cette compétition professionnelle, placée sous la supervision de la Fédération anglaise de football, a été fondée en 1888, et connait son format actuel depuis 1992.

programme.title: Saint-Malo / Marseille
programme.desc: L'affiche entre l'US Saint-Malo et l'Olympique de Marseille constitue le match de clôture de la 8e journée de l'Arkema Première Ligue. Promu dans l'élite du football féminin cette saison, le club malouin est le seul représentant breton en Première Ligue. L'enjeu principal pour les "Diablesses" est le maintien au plus haut niveau. Du côté des Marseillaises, l'objectif sera évidemment de prendre les trois points de la victoire, pour confirmer leur excellent début de saison.

programme.title: Leeds / Tottenham
programme.desc: Les Peacocks de Leeds réalisent un excellent début de saison et devancent de grosses écuries, dont leur adversaire du jour, Tottenham, qui pointe en queue de classement. S'ils s'imposent face aux Spurs, Dominic Calvert-Lewin et ses coéquipiers pourraient intégrer le Top 5 et s'installer durablement comme le poil à gratter de ce championnat. A l'inverse, les Londoniens doivent impérativement l'emporter pour entamer leur remontée.

programme.title: Nottingham Forest / Manchester City
programme.desc: Cette rencontre met aux prises deux équipes aux dynamiques bien distinctes en ce début de saison. Le leader Manchester City se déplace à Nottingham, englué dans la zone rouge.

programme.desc: Focus sur la rencontre qui oppose les surprenants et imprévisibles Norvégiens de Bodo/Glimt aux Dogues lillois.

Plus jeune Français à ce niveau, il détonne par son jeu flamboyant, sa fougue et une ascension fulgurante malgré son aversion pour le golf pendant sa jeunesse. Accompagné par son mentor et par une famille soutenante, le Landais de 21 ans veut continuer sa progression vers le sommet. A sa manière : " pleine balle ".

Coup de projecteur sur leur histoire et leur parcours.

programme.title: Vettel, le pionnier
programme.desc: Quadruple champion du monde de Formule 1, Sebastian Vettel vient de prendre sa retraite. Pilote surdoué, vainqueur de son 1er GP à 21 ans, il devient à 23 ans, au volant de sa Red Bull, le plus jeune champion du monde de l'histoire. C'est dans cette écurie qu'il construit sa légende, devenant le pionnier de cette équipe désormais incontournable en F1. Ce documentaire retrace l'immense carrière de Vettel : ses années Red Bull, son rêve inachevé chez Ferrari ainsi que ses prises de positions ces dernières saisons.

L'an passé, ce dernier s'était en effet imposé avec un score exceptionnel de -29 sous le par. Le joueur américain sera présent pour remettre son titre en jeu, tout comme d'autres anciens vainqueurs : Austin Eckroat (vainqueur en 2024) et Erik van Rooyen (vainqueur en 2023).

programme.title: Le podium

programme.title: Formula One, le mag
programme.desc: "Formula One, le mag" présente les actualités de la Formule 1. Derniers résultats, prochaines courses, interviews des pilotes, analyses des résultats avec l'équipe des experts de la chaîne, tout est à découvrir dans "Formula One, le mag".

programme.title: Jean Todt, la méthode
programme.desc: Jean Todt est l'une des figures les plus importantes du sport automobile dans le monde, et du sport en général. Partout où il est passé, il a inculqué la culture du travail et de la victoire, comme copilote, patron de Peugeot Sport, puis de la Scuderia Ferrari, et enfin président de la FIA. Depuis le début de sa carrière, il suscite admiration, respect, jalousie parfois, mais également fantasme, tant l'homme est secret et se livre peu. Jean Todt a ouvert les portes de son quotidien à Canal+ depuis décembre 2021.

Ils feront face au jury mais ils seront aussi confrontés pour la première fois au public du CANAL CHAMPIONS CLUB. Face à la pression, ils pourront alors compter sur l’accompagnement d’Anne-Laure Salvatico.

Sous le regard bienveillant de Rédouane Bougheraba et toujours en public, ils tenteront de convaincre le jury. A la clé, deux places pour la grande finale pour commenter un match en intégralité au Parc des Princes.

programme.title: Au micro ! Une nouvelle voix pour le foot
programme.desc: C’est la dernière ligne droite pour les deux finalistes. Après avoir réussi toutes les épreuves de la compétition, ils s’apprêtent désormais à se confronter à un ultime défi : commenter un match de Ligue des Champions dans les mêmes conditions qu’un journaliste de CANAL+, depuis la tribune de presse du Parc des Princes. Pour se préparer, ils pourront compter sur les conseils de Paul Tchoukriel. Qui rejoindra l’équipe de commentateurs de CANAL+ ?

programme.title: Sambo : Championnat du monde
programme.desc: Découvrez des épreuves du Championnat du monde de Sambo, un art martial apparu en URSS dans les années 1930, fruit d'un mélange de judo, de boxe et de lutte. La première édition a eu lieu en 1973, et elle regroupe à chaque édition les athlètes de 11 pays. A noter que les femmes n'ont participé qu'à une seule édition en 1983. programme.desc: Cette saison, Oihan Guillamoundeguy découvre la première division européenne. programme.title: 4e tour

programme.title: Tadej Pogacar - Anatomy of a Goat
programme.desc: Tadej Pogačar steht im Mittelpunkt dieser Radsport-Dokumentation. Der Slowene zählt zu den erfolgreichsten Fahrern seiner Generation und hat mit fünf Gesamtsiegen bei der Tour de France längst einen festen Platz in der Radsportgeschichte. "Anatomy of a Goat" blickt auf Pogačars außergewöhnliche Fähigkeiten und seine Erfolge und geht der Frage nach, was den 1998 geborenen Profi zum Ausnahmekönner macht. Im Fokus steht dabei der Sportler hinter dem Mythos des "GOAT".

programme.title: Motorsport: FIA-Langstrecken-WM - 6 Stunden von Barcelona
programme.desc: Dieses Jahr sicherte sich das Toyota-Racing-Team mit der Startnummer 8 den ersten Platz auf dem Circuit de Barcelona-Catalunya. Das Sieger-Trio bildeten Sébastien Buemi, Brendon Hartley und Ryō Hirakawa. René Rast landete zusammen mit Robin Frijns und Sheldon van der Linde schließlich außerhalb der Top Ten.

programme.title: Motorsport: FIA-Langstrecken-WM - 6 Stunden von Monza
programme.desc: Übertragung des 6-Stunden-Rennens von Monza im Rahmen der FIA Langstrecken-Weltmeisterschaft. Beim Saisonfinale der FIA-Langstrecken-WM geht es über sechs Stunden auf dem Autodromo Nazionale Monza um die letzten Punkte der Saison. Die Hypercars und LMGT3-Boliden kämpfen auf dem 5,79 Kilometer langen Kurs um den Sieg und die WM-Titel. Lange Geraden, hohe Geschwindigkeiten und harte Bremsmanöver an den Schikanen stellen Fahrer und Fahrzeuge vor besondere Anforderungen. Toyota, BMW, Ferrari und die weiteren Hersteller treten zum letzten Rennen des Jahres an.

programme.title: Eiskunstlauf: Grand Prix - Cup of China
programme.desc: Übertragung der Kür der Herren beim Cup of China im Rahmen der ISU Grand Prix Serie der Eiskunstläufer. Aus dem Chongqing Huaxi Culture and Sports Center.

programme.title: Radsport: Querfeldein-Europameisterschaften
programme.desc: Übertragung der Europameisterschaft 2026 im Rad-Querfeldein in Zeddam in den Niederlanden. Bei dieser EM müssen die Fahrer einen Kurs bewältigen, der aus Feldwegen, Straßen, Waldpfaden und Sandpassagen besteht, der noch dazu mit Hindernissen ausgestattet ist. Erstmals ausgetragen wird auch eine Mixed-Staffel.

programme.title: Tadej Pogacar - Anatomy of a Goat
programme.desc: Tadej Pogačar steht im Mittelpunkt dieser Radsport-Dokumentation. Der Slowene zählt zu den erfolgreichsten Fahrern seiner Generation und hat mit fünf Gesamtsiegen bei der Tour de France längst einen festen Platz in der Radsportgeschichte. "Anatomy of a Goat" blickt auf Pogačars außergewöhnliche Fähigkeiten und seine Erfolge und geht der Frage nach, was den 1998 geborenen Profi zum Ausnahmekönner macht.
